{{Quote|Apparently, Master Gnost-Dural took as many Jedi as he could find and established a hidden colony on the planet with the help of civilian volunteers.|[[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:TLC" />}}
The '''Jedi Colony''' was a settlement established after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. The settlement was established by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] with hopes of gathering [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that survived the conflict. Eventually [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble]], [[Nadia Grell]], [[Kalikori village|Kalikori]] [[Pilgrims]] and colonists joined Dural on the planet, where they developed advanced agriculture techniques that allowed them to grow [[Plant/Legends|plants]] on the planet despite its toxic and [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] terrain. The Jedi [[Tau Idair]] served as the head of security on the Colony.<ref name="TOR:TLC" />
